confidence_scope: Frozen numerical support matrix, exported navigation graph, bounded exhaustive optimum and audited CSV/geometry only.
review_scope_note: Independent AI review and independently implemented Python enumeration/CSV/sample-footprint audit; not human peer review or independent IK/physical validation.
what_results_support: On the fixed task-support matrix, full coverage and exact minimum dock counts 2/4/4 are preserved while the joint method lowers the stated weighted navigation objective in all three modes.
Position and wipe routes shorten; grasp raw route length is unchanged and only its endpoint-heading term decreases.

The fixed-set reorder control preserves staged candidate sets and independently attains their optimal ordering. Joint improvement beyond it supports a dock-selection effect, not only a permutation effect.
All minimum covers and needed edges were independently reconstructed; exhaustive Python tour enumeration matches every joint optimum.
Main-scene-style figures use actual exported paths, physical dock poses/headings and exactly-once supported task assignments without changing geometry.
what_results_dont_support: A claim that all task modes have shorter raw routes, or that endpoint yaw cost equals integrated path turning effort.
Continuous-space or arbitrary repeated-visit walk optimality; the certificate covers the given regional partition, binary minimum-cover layer and Hamiltonian tours on the computed oracle.
Independent IK, manipulator/self/inter-arm collision, inter-task arm transition, contact force or physical task success.
General superiority, statistical significance, runtime efficiency, robustness, or a scalable/novel algorithm merely because exhaustive search beats a staged heuristic.
missing_evidence: Held-out layouts, heights, task/path directions, candidate-density and IK-budget saturation studies.
Full computational accounting and randomized/repeated timings if efficiency is claimed, including navigation graph construction.
Equal-budget strong navigation-aware baselines, a scalable variant and component ablations before method-level superiority claims.
Calibrated models, independent collision-aware arm/transition validation, measured docking uncertainty and physical execution for corresponding claims.
suggested_claim_revision: 在固定VX300s模型、两桌10目标和136候选的离散任务支持矩阵上，联合停靠/访问序列搜索保持10/10任务支持和2/4/4次最少停靠，将既定加权导航代价降低20.30%、1.37%、11.10%。其中位置和擦拭的原始路线缩短20.22%、10.75%；抓取距离不变，仅端点朝向项减少。最优性限于给定支持分区、最少覆盖层和计算导航图上的单次访问闭环。
next_experiments_needed: Full-cost repeated timings and scalable search comparison
Independent collision-aware arm and transition validation
